title: Vite dep preloads resolve against document.baseURI — always the host page in content scripts
trigger: A lazy import() inside a bundled content script fails in production with 'Unable to preload CSS for /assets/...' while unit tests and the dev build work fine.
principle: Vite wraps lazy imports in __vitePreload, which fetches dependency chunks/CSS relative to document.baseURI. In a content script that is the host page's origin, so every preload 404s and the rejection propagates, silently aborting any Promise.all init path. modulePreload: false still keeps CSS deps (FOUC guard), so the reliable fix is window.addEventListener('vite:preloadError', e => e.preventDefault()) early in the content script — the event is the designed escape hatch; the real chrome-extension:// import then proceeds. Verify production-only init paths with E2E, never trust unit tests for bundler behavior.

cases.context: initHeavyFeatures (OCR + Study Mode init) never ran in the packed extension: the lazy subtitle chunk's CSS preload 404'd against the mock page origin, rejecting Promise.all before initializeStudyModeController.
cases.bad:
// relying on modulePreload: false alone
build: { modulePreload: isExtension ? false : undefined } // CSS deps still preload
